quests.title: Three Kinds of Hands
quests.summary: Gather the yard's, the mill's and the Wall's own stories so a derelict mill in Belfast can reopen as a workshop of Ulster's trades.

steps.text: Hear out Nuala Orr, the archivist at the Linen Hall Library.
Read the yard board at Titanic Belfast.
Find Mervyn Hanna on the Belfast streets, then hear him out in the yard.
Sing the dockers' song with the singer in the yard.
Read the plaque on the 1907 strike in the yard.
Look at the bolt of linen in Lisburn Road Linens.
Hear the old weaver's story in Lisburn Road Linens.
Go south to the Mournes and hear the waller by the Wall.
Mend the gap in the Mourne Wall.
Read the plaque about the Wall builders beside the gap.
Take the three testimonies back to Nuala at the Linen Hall.
Walk into the reopened Hands Mill, on the south side of Belfast.

quests.reward: The Hands of Ulster Tally Token, a Flaxling, Ulster fry and soda farls, and standing in Northern Ireland. The Hands Mill opens.
